description: Multi-step (elementary-step decomposition) DFT targets. Each target is split into ordered elementary steps; each step has its own dry R/P endpoints and an optional explicit-water microsolvation spec. N=1 step is allowed (single-TS run with built-in microsolvation).

literature.source: Hofmann/Lederer aqueous Amadori review; water-catalysed regime

targets.notes: Schiff-base -> ketoamine (Amadori) via 1,3-prototropic H transfer from the hydroxyl O0 to the imine N3. Dry concerted barrier ~73 kcal/mol (strained 5-membered TS); with one explicit water as proton shuttle the topology becomes a 7-membered ring and the barrier drops to ~20 kcal/mol (literature regime). After microsolvation the new water atoms are appended to the existing 33-atom solute, so indices 33 (Ow), 34, 35 (Hw) belong to the bridging water. The TS imaginary mode should be concentrated on the donor (0), acceptor (3), the migrating H (17), and the water (33-35).
